notes.title: New game " Don't Look Behind " will be released in June
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038060/7eee06db09cca77d90d0cde9fb795bd4c193a5a2.png[/img]Hello dear player
First of all , a huge THANK YOU for all your support my game
I am excited to tell you , my new game "Don't Look Behind" will officially release In June
this is a short horror game with a new game play
If you like my game "FORK ROAD" then this game is for you
I hope it can bring you more interesting gaming experience.
Now you can add it to your wish list
Thank you again for your support! :)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721080/_/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721080/_/[/url]

notes.title: Happy New Year 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038060/b8cb70fdb153ca5888c28cf625b05c9350d6bfdf.png[/img]Happy New Year 2025,
2024 is a very special year
My game "Fork Road" sold over 30,000
It's a great success for an indie game developers
Thank you for your support
Next year, I hope to bring you a better gaming experience
The next game is in works, I don't have a completion date yet, I'm aiming to launch it in the spring of 2025, I'll update when I get more progress,
Wish everyone have a great year and keep enjoy video games :)

notes.title: Update 0613
notes.content:
